articles.title: JEET AI Introduces AI Tutor Starting at ₹1,499 Per Month - SMEStreet
articles.content: Technology For SMEs IoT & AI JEET AI Introduces AI Tutor Starting at ₹1,499 Per Month JEET AI launches an interactive AI tutor in Hindi for JEE and Foundation courses, offering personalised teaching, assessments and practice from ₹1,499 per month. SMEStreet Edit Desk 22 Oct 2026 17:25 IST Follow Us New Update Listen to this article 0.75x 1x 1.5x 00:00 / 00:00 JEET AI introduces India’s first AI Tutor that truly teaches, replicating the experience of learning with a personal teacher. Rather than waiting for students to ask questions, it actively teaches concepts, writes and annotates on a virtual board, presents relevant multimedia content, and uses interactive simulations to simplify complex topics. For instance, while teaching a concept in Chemistry, JEET AI can illustrate chemical reactions, explain the underlying science through visual demonstrations, and pause to test whether the student has understood the concept before moving forward. Just like a good teacher, it continuously checks comprehension, asks questions, and tests students throughout the lesson, adapting its explanations based on their understanding. Students can interrupt at any moment, ask unlimited questions, and request explanations repeatedly, without hesitation or judgment. JEET AI has launched with teaching capabilities in Hindi, with support for additional Indian languages, including Tamil and Kannada, set to be introduced in the coming months. For decades, students have relied on coaching centres, recorded lectures, and YouTube videos to prepare for their examinations. However, teaching hundreds of students simultaneously has made truly personalized learning nearly impossible. While personal tutoring offers individual attention, its high cost makes it inaccessible to most families. AI chatbots have made doubt solving easier than ever but answering questions and actually teaching are two very different things. JEET AI has set out to bridge this gap, bringing personalized teaching to students across India at a starting price of just ₹1,499 per month. Ritvik Kulshrestha, Founder of Jeet AI and CEO of Extramarks Education, said, "For centuries, the best form of education has been a great teacher sitting beside a student, understanding their difficulties, and adapting to their needs. Unfortunately, this level of personal attention has always been a privilege available to very few. With JEET AI, we are using technology to change that. Our goal is not to build another tool that answers questions, but to make the experience of having a great personal teacher accessible to every student." Combining over 15 years of educational expertise, proprietary content, and pedagogical research from Extramarks Education, JEET AI goes beyond conventional AI tools to deliver an immersive, interactive learning experience that replicates a personalized one-on-one learning environment. Whether mastering a concept, learning an entire subject, or preparing for JEE or school examinations, JEET AI delivers structured, interactive, and personalized teaching, followed by targeted practice and comprehensive assessments to identify learning gaps and ensure thorough understanding and mastery of every concept. Starting at just ₹1,499 per month, JEET AI aims to make personal tutoring affordable at an unprecedented scale. While conventional coaching programmes can cost lakhs of rupees, often...

articles.title: IIM Udaipur launches one-year MBA in investment, wealth management - ET Education
articles.content: Higher Education 2 min read IIM Udaipur launches one-year MBA in investment, wealth management IIM Udaipur has launched India's first one-year full-time residential MBA program in Investment and Wealth Management, developed with leading financial services firms in India. The institute has collaborated with leading investment management firms, like JM Financial, LGT Wealth India, Nippon India AMC, to align the learning experience with industry practices and professional requirements. ANI Updated On Oct 22, 2026 at 01:14 PM IST Select ETEducation as Preferred Choice on Google Copy Link Share on WhatsApp Share on Linkedin Share on X Share on Telegram Share on Facebook IIM Udaipur Launches India's First One-Year Full-Time MBA in Investment and Wealth Management Udaipur: The Indian Institute of Management Udaipur ( IIM Udaipur ) launched its One-Year MBA in Investment and Wealth Management (IWM), becoming the first and only IIM to offer a dedicated One-Year Full-Time Residential MBA Program in this domain. This pioneering initiative reflects the Institute's commitment to developing specialised management education that responds to emerging industry needs and evolving career opportunities in the financial services sector. The Program comes at a time when India's financial services sector is experiencing significant growth and transformation. Changing investor expectations, evolving financial markets, technological advancements, and increasingly sophisticated financial products are creating a growing need for professionals with specialised knowledge and managerial capabilities in investment and wealth management. Advt A key distinguishing feature of the Program is its co-creation with leading investment and wealth management firms in India, including 360 ONE, ASK Private Wealth, Client Associates, IIFL Wealth, InCred Wealth, JM Financial, LGT Wealth India, Nippon India AMC, and Nuvame Wealth. These industry partners contribute to curriculum development and review, deliver guest lectures and workshops, and host participants for a one-month industry immersion. This close collaboration between academia and industry helps align the learning experience with contemporary industry practices and professional requirements. By combining IIM Udaipur's academic rigour with the practical expertise of industry practitioners, the Program aims to equip participants with specialised investment knowledge, wealth advisory capabilities, ethical judgement, and an understanding of client needs-competencies essential for building trusted client relationships and navigating the evolving financial services landscape. Prof. Rajesh Agrawal, Chairperson, One-Year MBA Programs, IIM Udaipur, said: "India's growing financial wealth and increasingly complex investment landscape call for professionals who combine technical expertise with sound judgement and a deep understanding of client needs. Our One-Year MBA in Investment and Wealth Management has been designed to address this need through a distinctive combination of academic rigour and industry expertise. Co-created with leading investment and wealth management firms, the Program emphasises trust, ethics, and fiduciary responsibility while preparing experienced professionals for careers in asset management, private banking, wealth advisory, and family offices. We look forward to developing thoughtful investment professionals, trusted advisors, and responsible leaders for the evolving financial services industry." Advt With this launch, IIM Udaipur further expands its portfolio of specialised One-Year MBA programs, complementing its existing offerings in Digital Enterprise Management and Global Supply Chain Management.
